import os
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
import aioboto3
import uvicorn

os.environ["AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK"] = os.getenv("BEDROCK_API_KEY", "")

app = FastAPI()
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"])
app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=".", html=True), name="static")

session = aioboto3.Session()
MODEL_ID = "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0"

@app.post("/api/generate")
async def generate(data: dict):
    messages = data.get("messages")
    if messages is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No data provided")
    bedrock_messages = [
        {
            "role": "assistant" if m.get("role") == "ai" else m.get("role", "user"),
            "content": [{"text": m.get("content", "")}]
        }
        for m in messages
    ]
    async with session.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name="us-east-1") as client:
        resp = await client.converse(
            modelId=MODEL_ID,
            messages=bedrock_messages,
            inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": 64000}
        )
    return {"content": resp["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"]}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
